HiBob (Hi Bob Ltd., Israel; HiBob, Inc., US subsidiary) is a modern HRIS platform for mid-market companies. HiBob's Terms of Service explicitly disclaim any uptime warranty — the platform is provided "AS IS" with no guarantee of uninterrupted service availability. Enterprise customers should negotiate custom SLA terms directly with HiBob.
